title: How early should you arrive at Leeds Bradford Airport?
author: Brogan
cover_image_alt: A red passport tucked under the handle of a blue hard-shell suitcase
intro: Two hours before your flight is the usual advice for Leeds Bradford, with extra time on early mornings and in the school holidays. Here's how to work out the right time, plus the drop-off charge and how to get there.
seo_title: Leeds Bradford Airport: arrive 2 hours before? (2026)
seo_description: About 2 hours before most flights, more on early mornings and school holidays. Leeds Bradford security, bag drop, the £8 drop-off charge and getting there.

sections.heading: The short answer
sections.text:
- **Hand luggage only:** about 2 hours
- **Bags to drop:** 2 to 2½ hours
- **Early mornings:** add 30 minutes
- **School holidays:** add 30 minutes

This is the timing most airlines and travel guides suggest for Leeds Bradford, checked in October 2026. Your airline sets the deadlines that really matter, for bag drop and the boarding gate, and they're on your booking. Procedures change, so check the airport's and the airline's current advice before you travel.

sections.heading: One terminal, a busy first wave
sections.text:
Leeds Bradford has a single terminal, so there's no risk of going to the wrong one. Its recent extension added a bigger security hall, which has helped with queues.

The busy time is the first wave of departures. Like most UK holiday airports, many flights leave early in the morning, roughly between 6 and 9am, and security and bag drop are at their busiest then. Late afternoon can be busy too. Midday is usually quieter, and the school holidays are the other pressure point, especially the first weekend of the summer holidays and the October and February half terms, when Jet2 and Ryanair flights to the sun are full.

sections.heading: How long to allow, worked out
sections.text:
| Trip | Flight | Arrive |
| --- | --- | --- |
| City break, hand luggage only | Midday on a Wednesday | **About 2 hours** before |
| Sun holiday, bags to drop | 6.30am in August | **2½ hours** before, around 4am |
| Ski or winter sun, bags to drop | Saturday morning in February half term | **2½ hours** before |
| Late afternoon, hand luggage only | 5pm on a Friday | **2 hours** before |

On a quiet midweek flight, two hours is plenty. On a summer or half-term morning, bag drop and security can both have queues, and the gate closes before the published departure time.

sections.heading: Security and liquids
sections.text:
Leeds Bradford was one of the first UK airports to fit new scanners that let you leave liquids and laptops in your bag. That doesn't mean bigger bottles, though: according to the airport, liquids still need to be in containers of 100ml or less.

Tip: pack your 100ml liquids where you can reach them anyway, in case you're asked to take them out. Rules differ between UK airports, and the airport you fly home from may still want them in a clear bag.

sections.heading: Dropping off and getting there
sections.image_alt: Rows of parked cars in a large airport car park at night under orange lights
sections.image_caption: Pre-booked parking is usually far cheaper than turning up on the day.
sections.text:
Leeds Bradford has no railway station, so most people arrive by car, taxi or bus.

- **Drop-off:** the drop-off car park outside the terminal costs £8 for up to 10 minutes since March 2026, with higher charges for longer stays. That makes it one of the dearest in the UK.
- **Free option:** reports say there's a free drop-off area a few minutes' walk from the terminal, but check where it is and its time limit on the airport's website first.
- **By bus:** Flyer bus services link the airport with Leeds and Bradford. Early morning buses are limited, so check the first one will get you there in time.
- **Parking:** book ahead, as turning up costs much more.

Watch out: the airport sits on high ground, and fog and snow can slow the roads in winter. Allow extra time for the drive on winter mornings.

sections.heading: Five ways to make the airport easier
sections.text:
- **Check in online** as soon as it opens, and download your boarding pass to your phone.
- **Travel with hand luggage only** if you can, so you can skip bag drop.
- **Know your bag drop deadline**, which is earlier than boarding, and work back from it.
- **Consider Fast Track** for a summer or half-term morning. Prices are on the airport's website.
- **Head to the gate when it's called:** gates close before the departure time on your ticket.

sections.heading: Where could you go from Leeds Bradford?
sections.text:
Leeds Bradford's flights are mostly short and medium-haul, to the Mediterranean, the Canaries and European cities. For winter sun, look at [Lanzarote](/destinations/lanzarote) or [Tenerife](/destinations/tenerife), and for a city break, [Krakow](/destinations/krakow) or [Prague](/destinations/prague).

Our guide to [direct flights from Leeds Bradford](/blog/where-can-you-fly-direct-from-leeds-bradford-airport) has the full list, and the [city breaks](/destinations/city-breaks) page has more ideas. If your family can't agree, read our guide to [deciding where to go on holiday](/how-to-decide-where-to-go-on-holiday).

faqs.question: How early should I get to Leeds Bradford Airport?
faqs.answer: About two hours before a flight with hand luggage only, and two to two and a half hours if you have a bag to drop. Add time on early mornings and in the school holidays.

faqs.question: Is 2 hours enough at Leeds Bradford Airport?
faqs.answer: For most flights, yes. On a busy summer or half-term morning with bags to drop, allow two and a half hours.

faqs.question: How much is drop-off at Leeds Bradford Airport?
faqs.answer: Since March 2026, the drop-off car park costs £8 for up to 10 minutes, rising for longer stays. Check the airport's website for the current price and any free drop-off option.

faqs.question: Can you take liquids through security at Leeds Bradford?
faqs.answer: Yes, in containers of up to 100ml. The new scanners mean you can usually leave them in your bag, but the size limit still applies.
